t: A wearable e-paper name badge with Wi-Fi that you program in MicroPython.
steps: Buy the badge or the STEM kit from Pimoroni, PiShop.us, Adafruit, or The Pi Hut.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Use the five buttons to explore the built-in app launcher.
Open the Badgeware docs and try the web playground or simulator.
Install Thonny on your computer for writing MicroPython.
Double-tap reset to open the USB drive mode.
Copy a sample app over and change the text it shows.
meta: Open Code. From $58.65. A few stores.
